title: Learned net2 against learned neto2 in closed loop on validation links: same offline training, 36 policies
description: exp-net2-offline-v9c-252 trained expliCCit's memoryless actor offline with TD3+BC (alpha 5 and alpha 10, 200000 steps, training seeds 0 to 2, step data exp-data-net2-steps-222) on our distribution net1s: net1 v7 (7 LCFs, exp-net1v6-229) and net1 v9 (27 LCFs, exp-net1v9-243), reading each LCF's distribution summed into 4 bins (bins4) or the means only (means). exp-neto2-search2-245 trained the same actor with the same arms, data and seeds on neto1 v1 (7 heads, exp-net1-point-228) and neto1 v2 (27 heads, exp-neto1-v2-239). Here all 24 net2 policies (net2-NET1-VIEW-ARM-sSEED) and the 12 neto2 policies at the same two arms (neto2-NET1-ARM-sSEED) run in closed loop in one release, beside BBRv3 and, as reference lines only, the fixed rule on net1 v9 at u = 0.25 (rule-v9) and on neto1 v2 at u = 0.375 (rule-v2), on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies, campaign seed 21 (the seed of exp-neto2-search2-val-247, whose neto2 scores this run should reproduce). The learner is held fixed, so a difference between net2 and neto2 comes from the estimator and from what it hands over. summary.md scores each controller against BBRv3 and names the best policy of each group (chosen.json); versus-rule-v9.md pairs each controller with the rule on net1 v9 by link. Read per-arm means over the three training seeds, not single policies: seeds spread by about 0.05 for neto2. This is a comparison on validation links before any tuning of net2 and supports no claim about the held-out test links.
prepare: N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N2="$IN/v2/$(cat "$IN/v2/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v2" "$N2" --u 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v2=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.375.onnx"); for a in "$IN"/n/net2-* "$IN"/o/neto2-*-td3bc-a5-200k-s* "$IN"/o/neto2-*-td3bc-a10-200k-s*; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$a")=$a/policy.onnx"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 76 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s --best net2-v7 net2-v9 neto2-v1 neto2-v2 && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v9
